maddeler.e:
نستدل (form X)
# نَسْتَدِلُّ (nastadillu) /nas.ta.dil.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
# نَسْتَدِلَّ (nastadilla) /nas.ta.dil.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
# نَسْتَدِلِّ (nastadilli) /nas.ta.dil.li/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
